node.statement: Fix any t>=0 and any finite family of one-dimensional t-projections P_1,...,P_m in an extended t-C*-algebra, and suppose e:=2t satisfies e<=e_PQR, e<=e_dim, and C_PQR*e<=1/2, where the constants are as in the two named externals. Then the relation j~k iff dim S_{P_j,P_k}=1 is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive, hence is an equivalence relation.
